 What FanCash is, and how to spend it
 FanCash is not just a bonus bet! FanCash is Fanatics loyalty currency you can redeem across Fanatics experiences, as bonus bets inside the Fanatics Sportsbook and Fanatics Casino, or for tickets, trading cards, and merchandise on Fanatics.com . FanCash is the most versatile form of bonus currency provided by any sportsbook. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Fanatics Sportsbook promo code terms
 New customers only: 21+ and in a Fanatics state. New York is excluded from this offer.
 Minimum deposit: $20 to fund the initial bet.
 Opt-in required: Toggle on this promotion on your first bet slip; you must place a wager within seven days of registration.
 Daily limit: Daily opt-ins are required for up to seven days, with $50 FanCash awarded per daily opt-in; all FanCash associated with this promotion expires 24 hours after it is issued.
 Playthrough: FanCash carries a 1x requirement and cannot be withdrawn.
 Winnings: A FanCash stake is excluded from the payout, which is calculated on cash only.
 How to claim Fanatics Sportsbook promo code YAHOO350
 Follow the links on this page to Fanatics Sportsbook.

 Apply promo code YAHOO350 in your bet slip and place a wager of $20 or more (min odds -500) within seven days of registering.
 FanCash rewards of $50 each day are available for your first seven days, but you must opt-in each day to claim the FanCash. 
 Daily FanCash rewards expire 24 hours from receipt. FanCash is valid for Fanatics experiences, including tickets, trading cards, merch and more!
